content:
IDC today released a report pointing out that Huawei and Apple are the only manufacturers to record smartphone shipment growth in China in the second quarter of 2026. Details are as follows.

The results mark the fifth consecutive quarter of year-on-year decline in shipments.

The report shows that Apple recorded the strongest year-on-year shipment growth among mainstream smartphone manufacturers in China in the second quarter of 2026, with an increase of 24.4%.

Driven by this, Apple's ranking jumped from fifth to second place, with its market share rising from 13.9% to 18.1%. Huawei continued to maintain its market leadership, accounting for 22.6% of smartphone shipments in the quarter.

That said, other major smartphone manufacturers all recorded year-on-year declines, with shipment drops of up to 60.8% amid rising memory and component costs, the withdrawal of government subsidies, and weaker consumer demand (particularly during the 618 shopping festival).

Overall, the Chinese smartphone market declined 4.3% year-on-year, with shipments of approximately 66 million units in the quarter.
